facts.name: Laurie E. Buchanan
facts.assignment: Profile: Okeechobee all civil, probate/guardianship and dependency cases; half domestic relations (even DR numbers), with listed juvenile/specialty support. Administrative judge domestic relations/unified family court.

procedure_checklist.chambers_communications: Email the judicial office with case number, case name and subject; copy all parties unless an ex parte communication is legally authorized.
procedure_checklist.hearing_scheduling: File motion first. Guide directs hearings under one hour to online scheduling and hearings over one hour to an emailed request with filed motion and time estimate. Coordinate and promptly file/serve notice; consult guide for cancellation steps.
procedure_checklist.conferral: Guide requires good-faith civil conferral and certificate, or statement that Rule1.202 does not require conferral.
procedure_checklist.motion_submissions: Paperless office: motions as PDF and proposed orders as Word attachments; use the separately labeled foreclosure/probate submission addresses when applicable.
procedure_checklist.proposed_orders: Email Word order with cover letter specifying agreement or disagreement and complete service addresses; circulate and submit within guide deadlines or as otherwise ordered.
procedure_checklist.courtesy_copies: Email memoranda and relevant authorities in advance; guide distinguishes three business days for special-set materials from three days for evidentiary courtesy copies.
procedure_checklist.remote_appearances: Zoom for remote appearances; evidentiary hearings in person unless permission granted beforehand. Notice must identify remote or in-person appearance; see guide for connection and witness requirements.

conflicts: Courtesy-copy clauses use three business days for specified special-set materials and three days for evidentiary copies; both formulations retained without resolving overlap.
gaps: Scheduling headings distinguish less than and more than one hour; an exactly one-hour instruction is not explicit in reviewed headings.
facts.review_scope: Profile contacts, assignment and practical communications/scheduling/submission/appearance sections reviewed; sixteen-page PDF original collected, pages1-6 practical passages reviewed. No detailed family, probate, foreclosure merits, trial packets or calendars analyzed. Official site includes a staging-environment footer, preserved as observed; source is public official domain.
